scope: Dependency pinning, source-to-binary delivery, upstream release and downstream Konflux pipeline; read-only source review.

findings.finding: The GOWORK=off module precheck does not apply that setting to a subsequent build.
findings.correction: Apply GOWORK=off throughout checks and builds, then inspect the actual downloaded/extracted executable module metadata for intended Lighthouse identity and unexpected replacements.

findings.finding: The existing local candidate build is not the downstream build: Konflux uses strictfipsruntime and CGO_ENABLED=1 with hermetic prefetch.
findings.correction: Require successful downstream prefetch/build at the dependency-update revision and record the image index, tested platform digest, and embedded executable identity before QE qualification.
findings.qualification: No downstream incompatibility is demonstrated; the build is an unperformed acceptance gate.

findings.finding: make clean preserves dist/subctl-checksums.txt while the checksum recipe appends; reusing a release checkout can retain stale duplicate checksum entries.
findings.correction: Use a fresh checkout; if reusing explicitly delete the checksum file along with the relevant binaries and archives.

verified_paths: internal/verify/verify.go directly imports Lighthouse discovery tests.
release_subctl_on_push.yml uses a fresh checkout and targets the actual GITHUB_SHA, while recreating a mutable branch prerelease.
The Konflux pipeline uses root gomod prefetch, hermetic build, the stated Dockerfile, and four architectures.
RELATED_IMAGE_submariner-nettest takes precedence over the CLI override.
The verify framework derives its shared nettest image from cluster A, so swapping contexts requires preserving the selected digest.
limits: This source audit does not certify a published module, delivered binary, strict-FIPS build, live controller run, or QE rerun.
